reference.question: \(\frac{1}{2}\) of a road has been repaired, and \(\frac{2}{3}\) of that was repaired in the morning. What fraction of the entire road was repaired in the morning? Calculate: \(\frac{1}{2}\times\frac{2}{3}=\,?\)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Evaluate the supplied fraction product

\(\frac{1}{2}\times\frac{2}{3}=\frac{1}{3}\).
